title: Construct your prompt with annotation and voice
cardDesc: Draw and speak your ideas - we'll turn them into structured LLM prompts with spatial context understanding

sections.title: Motivation
sections.content: I often struggle with describing front-end UI details while vibe coding. I could use Figma, but switching tools kills momentum. Words work better, except when you're describing pixel-perfect layouts.

sections.title: Inspiration
sections.content: At McKinsey, partners solved this by annotating slides on Zoom while talking through their vision. Real-time markup plus verbal context. I built a tool that brings that workflow to AI prompting.

sections.title: Implementation
sections.content: The tech is simple: record audio, capture annotations, then feed both to GPT for detailed prompt generation. I added one twist: stitching before-and-after annotation images together gives the model extra context about what changed.

paragraphs: It's now part of my vibe coding workflow. Whenever I need to describe complicated or precise UI, I spin it up.
